source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/frhof/character-options.

summary: Once per turn, reduce damage you take from a spell or magical effect by 1d4 while not Incapacitated. Always prepared: Sacred Flame; choose Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma for casting. You may cast Sacred Flame as a Bonus Action Proficiency Bonus times per Long Rest. The alternate casting time is not automated.
